regression_run.change: temporary system prompt instruction: ask the user to confirm and wait before any refund
regression_run.case_result: e-005 passed 0 of 5 (baseline 5 of 5), CI decision block

revert_run.change: git revert of the temporary instruction; prompt version back to e9ca815022ce
revert_run.case_result: e-005 passed 5 of 5, CI decision pass

explanation: Run 1 added a temporary system prompt instruction: ask the user to confirm and wait for a reply before any refund, and never call issue_refund in the same turn as the request. e-005 and e-006, which expect a refund on a named order, each passed 0 of 5 against a baseline of 5 of 5. In all ten trials the agent looked up the order and asked for confirmation, so the issue_refund check failed at the verifier (reward 0.0, no infrastructure error) and CI blocked the job. The same instruction made the capability cases e-001 to e-003 pass 5 of 5, up from 0 of 5, because they ask for exactly that confirmation. Run 2 reverted the instruction: e-005 and e-006 passed 5 of 5 again, the capability cases returned to their baseline levels (e-001 to e-004 at 0 of 5), all 55 trials completed without errors, and the job succeeded. The original behaviour returned.
